Using \(f(x)=\frac{c}{x}\):

\[
f\left(f(x)+\frac2x\right)=f\left(\frac{c+2}{x}\right)=\frac{cx}{c+2}
\]

So

\[
f(x)f\left(f(x)+\frac2x\right)
=\frac{c}{x}\cdot \frac{cx}{c+2}
=\frac{c^2}{c+2}
=\frac13.
\]

Thus

\[
3c^2=c+2 \implies 3c^2-c-2=0 \implies (3c+2)(c-1)=0.
\]

Since \(c>0\), \(c=1\), so \(f(x)=\frac1x\). Then

\[
g(x)=\frac1x+4x^2.
\]

Minimize:

\[
g'(x)=-\frac1{x^2}+8x=0 \implies 8x^3=1 \implies x=\frac12.
\]

\[
g\left(\frac12\right)=2+4\cdot \frac14=3.
\]

\boxed{3}
